cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Lend Me the Edge
cards.instruction: Get someone to provide the one advantage you need without making the eventual success feel borrowed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What temperature won you the cake prize? Just the setting; I'm not taking on a co-baker. I taught you the sponge, and this recipe is mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Do you want my secret recipe as well?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep it. You measured properly at last, and I only need the number on the dial. I'll do the baking.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That temperature is most of the trick.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then whisper it while I set the oven. You can check I've copied the number, the way I checked yours; the entry still goes under my name.

reason: Give the exact Drive a concrete request, relevant pupil habit and responsive B4 development. Improve weak endings into things A actually needs B to do, without changing playable card wording.
